verdict.rationale: Aleph is a SaaS FP&A platform, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no bulk or full-account export in open formats. Its bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets sync is a reporting workflow feature, not a way to export all your data. The trial page's "cancel and remove your data" refers to deletion, not export, and probes found no public API spec that could serve as an export route.
